title: Orb Island
author: Seth Morrow
description: A 3D game made with box3dxt's b3k Kit: walk a floating island in the late afternoon sun, find the sixteen golden orbs and do not fall into the sea. Push a crate onto a pressure plate to open a vault, cross crumbling and turning platforms, ride lifts to a floating isle, dodge a wrecking ball and windmill sails, and touch flags to set checkpoints. Keyboard, mouse or gamepad, with sound. With render3dxt it is lit and glowing, with Kenney's animated hero, forests and models.
